_doc: HYP-05 pre-registration. Committed before any analysis runs. Gate clause specifies that this hypothesis does not run if HYP-03 SHIFT+WIDTH placebos match the real range.
title: Per-Instrument Edge vs Pooled Edge

gate.condition: HYP-03 SHIFT and WIDTH must not match the real range on trigger rate or gross expectancy
gate.action_if_gate_fails: close HYP-05 unrun; characterising heterogeneity in a non-signal is not informative
gate.rationale: If SHIFT and WIDTH match the real range, sections 2-5 would be studying heterogeneity in a signal that does not exist. The correct move is to stop rather than characterise noise across instruments.

h5a_variance_components.model: REML two-level random effects on day-clustered gross R, instrument-session level
h5a_variance_components.primary: tau_squared with profile-likelihood CI, and I_squared
h5a_variance_components.secondary: per-instrument shrinkage factor B_i = tau_sq / (tau_sq + sigma_i_sq)
h5a_variance_components.kill: I_squared < 0.25 or tau_squared CI includes zero -> pooling is correct, close cross-sectional line
h5a_variance_components.note: an uninformative CI is NOT evidence for homogeneity and will be reported as inconclusive, not as support for the null

h5b_rank_persistence.primary: Spearman rho between in-sample and holdout instrument-session gross expectancy rankings
h5b_rank_persistence.abort_if: fewer than 12 instrument-sessions clear the trade-count restriction
h5b_rank_persistence.secondary: top-quartile persistence: of top 5 in-sample, how many are top-10 in holdout? Expected under H0: 2.4

h5c_friction_viability.primary: per-instrument-session gap = E[gross_r] - cost_r, day-clustered CI, Holm over 21
h5c_friction_viability.report: full ordered gap table regardless of significance
h5c_friction_viability.note: cost_r_i is instrument-specific throughout (not pooled); friction table in doc shows 44x spread from ES to ETH

h5d_structural.model: meta-regression of instrument-session gross expectancy on primary regressors, weighted by inverse sigma_i_sq
h5d_structural.note: 21 observations; exactly two primary regressors; everything else labelled exploratory. Power caveat: at the edge of estimability, will overfit if run as a search.

h5e_shrinkage.primary: does shrunk in-sample family expectancy predict holdout net R better than raw, by OOS MSE
h5e_shrinkage.formula: mu_shrunk_i = B_i * y_i + (1 - B_i) * y_bar, B_i = tau_sq / (tau_sq + sigma_i_sq)
threshold_secondary_conditions: stratum-matched baseline: E[OOS | selected AND n>=400] - E[OOS | all n>=400], not unstratified population
establish whether the threshold scan touched the holdout; if so, a fresh OOS slice is required

clustering.report: both; treat the wider one as the honest bound
clustering.rationale: equity_index (ES/NQ/RTY), forex (6E/6J), crypto (BTC/ETH) are each effectively one cluster. Effective n ~ 6, not 10.

framing_constraint: No result in this document produces a tradable strategy. Ceiling is -0.046 R against required 0.062 (ES) to 2.719 (ETH TOK). This is stated before running any analysis and cannot be quietly promoted later.

section_7_checks.a: same-run confirmation: 38.3% predates the a5bdc2b holdout-pin fix; recompute if fix changed holdout membership
section_7_checks.b: n-effect check: compare P(positive) within matched holdout-trade-count strata

section_6_conditioner.scan_provenance_check: establish whether the trade_count >= 400 scan touched the holdout before proceeding
